verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents its own code path for custom agent skills, described as a 'Code way to build agentic skills. Built for power users and developers', and backs it with a dedicated Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide, so a documented format for writing your own skill exists. The pack gives only page titles for the guide itself and never describes how a skill is placed into or loaded by a local instance. missing for 10: the documented skill format or manifest details, explicit evidence of loading a custom skill into a local or self-hosted instance, hands-on or community corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: Agent skills: Code way to build agentic skills. Built for power users and developers.
